paragraphs: Tragedy has struck Spanish football following the death of Tenerife striker Jesús de Miguel at the age of 30.
The forward suffered severe head and chest injuries during a heavy collision with FC Andorra’s goalkeeper, who was sent off for the challenge.

De Miguel collapsed on the pitch and received emergency treatment while visibly shaken players and fans looked on. Reports indicate he suffered a cardiac arrest in the ambulance on the way to the hospital, where paramedics managed to resuscitate him. Although his condition was initially reported as stable but serious on Monday, his health rapidly deteriorated overnight.

Tenerife officially announced his tragic passing early Tuesday morning. The Spanish Football Federation has postponed scheduled Spanish Cup fixtures as the entire football community mourns the loss of the respected player, while authorities begin further investigations into the exact cause of death.

paragraphs: Spanish football is in mourning after Tenerife striker Jesús de Miguel died at age 30. During a second-division match against FC Andorra, he suffered head and chest injuries in a bad collision with the goalkeeper.

De Miguel collapsed on the field and was rushed to the hospital by paramedics, who had to help him after his heart stopped in the ambulance. On Monday, doctors said his condition was serious but stable, and family members came to visit him. But his health got much worse during the night, and his club confirmed his death on Tuesday morning.
Everyone at the club is heartbroken, and officials postponed some football matches to show respect for his family and friends.
